stages.name: public_boundary_and_export
checks: Exactly eight sample_reviewed records were exported.
All 51 public summary sections retain one or more book-page citations.
Original text, PDFs, OCR, SQLite, embeddings and local services were not exported.
Taiwan display-name metadata remains separate from book evidence.

stages.name: static_chat_and_safety
stages.tool: browser-side deterministic router plus Browser responsive test
checks: Traditional Chinese and English queries route to approved evidence and return Traditional Chinese answers.
The initial two-character Chinese plant-name matching defect was fixed and revalidated.
Constipation returns historical Podophyllum evidence with a modern-use warning.
Dose, non-Kohler, astrology and image-identification questions refuse within policy.

stages.name: security_and_portability
stages.tool: deterministic validator, git isolation and secret scan
checks: The public site is an independent git repository, not the AI_WORKSTATION repository.
No original_text field or recognized GitHub, Gemini or Google key pattern exists in public files.
The site has no external model call, analytics, database or backend dependency.
Desktop and 390px mobile layouts render without horizontal overflow.

stages.name: github_pages_release
stages.tool: GitHub CLI and live HTTPS browser regression
checks: Public repository minxinchen/kohler-plant-chat-demo was created from the isolated demo directory.
Main branch and annotated v0.1.0 tag were pushed.
GitHub Pages reports built with HTTPS enforcement.
The public URL returns HTTP 200, loads all eight plants and passes English, safety, scope and image refusal probes with no console errors.

warnings: This is a text-only public MVP, not a full-book release.
English input is supported, but v0.1.0 answers in Traditional Chinese.
Image reasoning remains disabled and the local chat API remains private.
